Full Management programme read. Seven programme research fields: marketing, strategy, innovation, HR, information systems, accounting/control and organization theory. No named Operations field; DRM laboratory is not Management Science department.
Full Mathematics programme read. CEREMADE doctoral research in analysis, probability, statistics, economics/finance mathematics, games and optimization; no named Operations field established.
Full Finance programme read. Finance fields, DRM and thesis preparation; no qualifying Operations/MS/IE title.
Full Economics programme read. Explicit eight programme fields concern economic disciplines and games, not Operations/MS/IE; LEDA and Mines collaboration distinct.
Full Law programme read. CR2D/DRJ legal thesis training, no qualifying named doctoral field.
Full Social Sciences substantive programme read. Three exact specialties sociology, political science and STS; Mines CSI branch distinct, no qualifying field.

Full official candidature overview read. Doctorat explicitly national academic research degree based on original scientific research and thesis; three-year funded research commitment, doctoral admission commission.

Full official 2018 PSL notice read. Explicitly states theses prepared in component institutions lead to doctorate awarded by PSL since 2015. This institutional statement does not retrospectively resolve each reported historical doctorate.
Full current official PSL graduate FAQ read. Graduate programmes do not create separate awards; doctorate prepared in component institutions, PSL diploma framework.
Full current LAMSADE homepage read. Exact full French laboratory name, OR and decision research, doctoral activity; retain laboratory type rather than department.

limitations: Current provider is Université Paris Dauphine - PSL, a component institution; doctoral awarding body PSL retained separately, not a duplicateOf merge. Reported historical faculty doctorate identities/dates remain unverified.
